text:
maya: starting planned shift for router pool B -> new-runtime-v2 at 23:00 UTC within the change window. will do 10% increments every 5m, hold checks at each step. pinging @sre-oncall and @pj for verification
deploy-bot: deploy started: router-config/v2 canary -> pool-b. batch=1, initial=10%, schedule=5m steps. logs: https://ci.internal/reports/2333333333
pj: ACK. I’ll watch latencies and 5xxs. quick check: config pin for session affinity enabled?
maya: yes pin=affinity=session_id, stickiness_ttl=900s. snippet: `route: /api -> backend: new-runtime-v2; stickiness: session_id; ttl: 900`
sre-oncall: watching, enabling extra tracing on the new routing path. alert thresholds set: p95 latency +20% or error rate >0.5% -> pause shift
tim: running smoke against the canary traffic now (400 reqs/min). no obvious failures so far. CPU on v2 is higher by ~8% but within target
maya: stepping to 20% in 30s. manual hold at each step if we see degradation
ops-bot: traffic-split: 10% -> 20% (initiated by maya)
pj: seeing a few 502 spikes around 23:07, looking at edge logs, might be connection pooling on new-runtime-v2
sre-oncall: flipping circuit-breaker thresholds to conservative for the canary group: failures-> short-circuit earlier. also enabling fallback to v1 for affected edge lanes
maya: hold shift, pausing automated schedule. rollback candidate? we can pin problematic routes back to runtime-v1 per-lane.
tim: reproing 502 locally with similar load; looks like a timeout with backend pool resizing. quick patch won't land before window closes
pj: agree pin lane eu-west-1 and ap-south-1 back to v1, keep 20% for others for narrowed blast radius
maya: executing per-lane pin: `rbctl pin route=eu-west-1 backend=new-runtime-v1 --reason "502 spikes"`
ops-bot: action acknowledged: pin applied to eu-west-1 by maya
sre-oncall: after pin, eu-west 502s dropped to baseline. ap-south still noisy, recommend draining ap-south pool and fallback entirely
maya: draining ap-south, moving its traffic to v1. will hold global shift at 20% until next sync. opening release-note update: "Partial rollback: eu-west-1/ap-south-1 pinned to v1 due to connection timeout under burst; continuing gradual rollout for other regions."
pj: noted. also creating a ticket for runtime-v2 connection pool tune (QOS and keepalive defaults)
tim: postmortem blurb: included repro steps and heap/connect stats.
deploy-bot: schedule paused by maya at step 3. next automated step canceled.
maya: team, plan is: keep current split (20% global with eu-west/ap-south pinned v1), iterate on pool tuning, re-run canary in next window. if no regressions, resume 5m increments. any objections? :thumbsup:
pj: +1
sre-oncall: +1, will keep alerts on and verbose traces for the next run
tim: +1, will validate fix and prepare a small config patch for next canary
maya: ok closing thread — I’ll post followup when we have the pool-tune PR and a new canary schedule. thanks all :rocket:
